The remaining uncertainty the old note recorded — the margin's Or, grace — is a lexical-gloss question that changes no unit boundary or head, so it is not a rule 16 competing analysis; it is kept in the note as information.

χάριν is tagged N-ASF and governed by σχῆτε with δευτέραν agreeing, so rule 46's postposition frame is not in question anywhere in this verse.
